text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Is it only this time...? *sigh* I've 
been waking up so early lately.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's because my part-time jobs have 
been all sitting down lately, but I feel 
like I haven't been moving my body 
enough...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, it's probably best 
to get some solid sleep. Alright, time to 
go back to sleep—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin was overflowing with too much 
motivation to run. Waking up way too early 
seems to have left her a bit 
sleep-deprived...
